claim_label: 方法选择：以下新增值均为待签署提案，不是已确认选择或实证结果
primary_question: 仅把MA趋势状态替换为MACD持续状态，能否在公平实际敞口下改善相对MA轮动的净样本外Calmar？

arms.selection: daily priority_desc then symbol_asc greedy up to three PIT-eligible symbols subject to identical category/group caps; no return ranking

arms.changed_component: replace trend at entry, retention, trend exit and same-group replacement candidates; remove MA hard exit
new-position entry requires h_previous<=0 and h_current>0; same trend exits and incumbent adjustments as REGIME

indicator_construction.common_support: all CS78 arms use identical PIT non-trend eligibility with at least 78 valid observations including today's one proxy close; unsupported symbols excluded before ranking in every CS78 arm
indicator_construction.prefix: all validated as-of observations from the fixed source start 2020-01-02 or later verified listing/source start; no sliding reseeding
indicator_construction.earlier_history_missing: record truncated-prefix identity; do not claim initialization convergence; frozen later data revision cannot silently change EMA seed
indicator_construction.previous_h: compute on the same rebased full prefix ending at the previous completed daily close; current h uses today's one ranking proxy Tick; never compare separate anchors or separate seeds
indicator_construction.missing_or_stale: no synthetic zero returns or automatic forward fill; fail closed and preserve positions/order failures in the account
indicator_construction.boundary: strict positive h is investable; h<=0 requires trend exit and later retry while exit is blocked

exposure_comparison.peak_uses: daily valuation plus observable intraday fill/pending-order risk states
exposure_comparison.if_unmatched: primary conclusion at most 观察; report raw Calmar only as unadjusted diagnostic; no outcome-based leverage or return scaling
exposure_comparison.matched_sleeve_future_protocol: any DEV-only executable exposure overlay needs a separately signed amendment before relevant OOS performance is opened

metric_definitions.equity: cash+actual_shares*raw_valuation_price+explicit_distribution_receivable; no adjusted-price return added to cash
metric_definitions.calmar: CAGR/MDD; undefined when MDD<=0, equity invalid, or segment shorter than 240 joint valuation sessions or 300 calendar days; short folds report return and drawdown without decision Calmar
metric_definitions.slippage: separately reconciled from fees and raw fills; counted once
metric_definitions.recovery: sessions and calendar days from prior equity peak until recovery; right-censor unrecovered episodes
metric_definitions.reverse_trend_exit: first trend-invalid exit target within 5/10 applicable sessions after actual new-position fill; target, filled exit and net loss reported separately
metric_definitions.trend_participation: ex-post non-overlapping 20-session windows on each PIT eligible symbol; reference raw-price-plus-distribution total return>=5%; sum(actual daily symbol weights over qualifying windows)/sum(20*0.20 over those same windows); common support, missing paths unclassified
metric_definitions.episode: actual new positive position until fully flat; partial trims not new episodes; overlapping same-group intervals across arms merged for sample-adequacy counting

risk_and_economic_guardrails.cost_limit_basis: also enforce charter calendar-year 75 CNY at the fixed initial 5000 basis, with partial years prorated by calendar days; stricter binding limit wins
risk_and_economic_guardrails.undefined_participation_or_zero_control: not evidence of pass; 观察 pending usable coverage
risk_and_economic_guardrails.reverse_exit_trigger_denominator: all eligible actual new-position entries with a complete 10-session follow-up; report numerator/denominator and censoring
risk_and_economic_guardrails.review_trigger_behavior: freeze research review; no forced entry or automatic parameter changes; acceptance requires disposition recorded
risk_and_economic_guardrails.hard_violation_behavior: 修改; preserve failure and do not replace the sample

sample_design_proposal.historical_oos_claim: retrospective held-out candidate only until phase6 prior-exposure ledger is signed; local prior unknown access is not treated as zero
sample_design_proposal.historical_accounts: all arms start with 5000 and empty positions on the same first development session with at least one PIT CS78-eligible symbol; continue equity, positions and fixed cap through all later historical segments; do not reset at folds
sample_design_proposal.disagreement_block: fixed 20-session grid from OOS start with at least one common eligible top5 symbol for which MA and MACD states disagree
sample_design_proposal.final_lock: prospective 12 calendar months from the first verified joint trading day after protocol+data+sample+implementation+baseline freeze and explicit lock-start authorization; exact dates must be written in phase6 sample identity before collection/evaluation
sample_design_proposal.final_lock_initial_positions: empty for all arms; seed indicators only from previously available history
sample_design_proposal.missing_required_history: 修改 data/sample dependency; no silent switch to complete daily close or a cherry-picked shorter interval

uncertainty.interval: two-sided percentile 95%, fixed linear empirical quantile interpolation
uncertainty.cagr_resample_time_basis: retain original segment elapsed calendar days and original number of joint sessions
uncertainty.fold_boundaries: sample blocks within each fixed OOS fold; preserve fold order and concatenate; never bridge validation or archived holdout
uncertainty.undefined_replicates: retain and count; if more than 1% undefined, interval unusable and decision at most 观察
uncertainty.dependence_and_nonstationarity_limit: conditional uncertainty sensitivity for a nonlinear path statistic; stationary weak-dependence assumptions require review; not a replayed executable 5000 account or guaranteed 95% coverage
uncertainty.primary_ci_pass: 20-session CI lower>0 and neither 10/40-session sensitivity CI lower<=0; all three valid
uncertainty.multiple_testing: one confirmatory H3; H1/H2/H4 and stress/attribution are descriptive with unadjusted intervals explicitly labelled, no secondary winner may substitute for primary
uncertainty.source_read_scope: primary-paper search abstract only; direct open 403; fixed bootstrap numbers are project choices, not literature-derived optimal values

scenarios.change: all explicit commission/minimum fee and other applicable fees times 2; same adverse price rule
incremental adverse slippage times 2; actual fill evidence not overwritten
generated target queued to next applicable closing-auction submission opportunity; no later information regenerates queued target; risk/account eligibility rechecked
same queued-target rule delayed two applicable submission opportunities
start all empty 5000 accounts 20 verified joint sessions later than nominal development start; same history seed, rules and sample boundaries
fixed membership from PIT eligible CS78 symbols at the common first admissible development account start; no later additions, retain delisting/suspension; census freeze before returns

stress_acceptance.mandatory: FEE2/SLIP2/DELAY1/DELAY2 each must pass validity, exposure gate and hard risk/cost limits; ΔCalmar>0, candidate CAGR>0, CAGR loss<=2pp; no bootstrap significance demanded in each stress cell
stress_acceptance.zero_base_slippage: SLIP2 invalid if base incremental adverse slippage is zero or unverified; requires phase4 nonzero adverse-fill parameter and explicit applicable version
stress_acceptance.delay_conflicts: newer signal cannot replace queued target; per-symbol latest generated eligible queue item processed FIFO, no overlapping artificial full fills; failed/expired submission logged using frozen phase4 queue contract
stress_acceptance.supplementary: START20/MATURE undefined or sparse => 观察, valid ΔCalmar<=0 => 观察; valid hard-rule breach => 修改

attribution_plan.regime_performance_in_this_batch: no unfrozen market classifier; only label-free calendar folds and attribution; later regime census/classifier requires preregistered version before output
attribution_plan.leave_one_contribution_out: remove net marked PnL contribution of each ETF/category/group/year from the reconciled account additively for concentration diagnostics; cash retained; no pretend reallocation; not a strategy rerun
attribution_plan.acceptance_veto: if removing any one ETF/category/group/calendar-year contribution makes candidate-minus-control net PnL advantage<=0, at most 观察
attribution_plan.alternative_explanations: retain all 12 theory classes as checked/unidentified; no causal mechanism acceptance

decision_rule_order.when: data/code/PIT/time/fill/cash reconciliation or frozen identity invalid; or any hard capital/exposure/risk/turnover/cost constraint violated

validity intact but historical OOS coverage/episodes/contamination review/exposure matching/usable intervals incomplete or sparse; never accept/淘汰 H3 from unmatched exposure; final-lock incompleteness vetoes acceptance but does not prevent reliable historical primary rejection
validity, exposure and sufficient pooled historical-OOS evidence intact, and primary 95% CI upper<0.10; reject this H3 economic increment, not all ETF rotation

validity+coverage+fair exposures complete; pooled historical-OOS Δ>=0.10 and primary/sensitivity CI pass; native CAGR>0, risk/economic/participation limits pass; mandatory and supplementary stresses plus concentration veto pass; prospective lock valid and ΔCalmar>0 with candidate CAGR>0 and same guardrails; only permits requesting separately authorized simulation
all other valid inconclusive cases, including failed stress/lock sign without reliable primary rejection; no automatic tuning

run_binding_requirements.null_semantics: dependency not yet established; draft must not be executed; each version and SHA256 to be supplied in a separately reviewed run-binding artifact before batch authorization
run_binding_requirements.cost_model_rule: same verified applicable dated commission/minimum/tax-exemption/other-fee/slippage model for every arm; existing sim/backtrader values are not defaults
run_binding_requirements.cash_model_rule: same broker-applicable yield/cash product accrual model; do not assume cash return zero
run_binding_requirements.fill_model_rule: raw applicable execution/auction data and explicit participation/limit/suspension/settlement/pending-state rules; without 14:57 history no same-design L2 claim
run_binding_requirements.universe_rule: PIT interest and universe event intersection with listing/delisting/category/group/priority available-time; today's 65-symbol pool cannot be used as clean historical membership
run_binding_requirements.approximate_L1_rule: a separately authorized labelled version only; no acceptance of economic H3 from current-pool/qfq fills
run_binding_requirements.material_binding_change: if verified availability demands rule/date/model changes, new protocol amendment signed before performance access
